name: Greater Albania
summary: Greater Albania (also called Ethnic Albania or Natural Albania) is a nationalist and irredentist idea that Albanians divided by the borders of 1913 should live in one state, taking in Kosovo and parts of North Macedonia, Montenegro, southern Serbia and Greek Chameria. Its carriers have ranged from the League of Prizren and wartime nationalists to the KLA and small groups such as the ANA. Today it is mostly held as a cultural and political aspiration of unification by consent, often alongside EU and NATO aims, and the idea itself carries no social or economic programme.
scope: The pan-Albanian national-unification claim as documented for the 1878 League of Prizren, the 1912 independence, the WWII unification, the KLA and post-1990 nationalists, and the contemporary mainstream that seeks unification by referendum or alongside EU integration. It excludes the Hoxha communist regime's non-irredentist policy and the violent fringe (ANA) except where noted. Economic and social answers are inferred and low confidence because the idea defines a territorial goal only.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Greater Albania is a territorial nationalism with no health policy; its modern carriers (e.g. Vetëvendosje) favour state health insurance, so a mild yes is inferred.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: No economic programme in the core idea; poverty is a recurring theme in Albanian nationalist politics, so a mild yes is inferred.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Adherents range from free-market nationalists to left-wing ones such as Vetëvendosje, so the ideology is indifferent.

public-ownership.rationale: The core claim is silent on ownership; nationalist parties span left and right on this.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: No stated line; the irredentist idea is economically unaligned across its parties.

unions-good.rationale: Never addressed by the concept; no consistent adherent position.

property-fundamental.rationale: Not part of the idea; adherents divided between liberal and left-wing parties.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Not addressed; no consistent line among nationalist parties.

cut-welfare.rationale: No stated position; Albanian nationalism is not defined by welfare policy.

worker-ownership.rationale: Nothing in the concept supports it; classed as outside a national-unification agenda and mostly opposed by its centre-right adherents.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Not addressed; ethnic-Albanian groups have both suffered and been accused of terrorism, so no clear line.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Traditional, nationalist and conservative social milieus dominate; inferred mild no.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Not addressed; adherents have been charged with inciting hatred yet also claim minority-rights protections.

strong-leader.rationale: Albanian nationalism historically opposed autocracy (Hoxha's rule suppressed the Kosovo cause), so a strong-leader answer is not typical; inferred.

state-harmful.rationale: The whole project aims at building a bigger, unified nation-state, which anarchism contradicts.

limit-guns.rationale: Not addressed; gun culture and KLA veneration pull one way, state-building the other.

empower-police-military.rationale: Nationalists emphasise national defence and veneration of the KLA; inferred mild yes.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Socially conservative milieu; inferred, not documented.

decide-locally.rationale: Ideology wants unification into one state, but also autonomy for Albanian areas; split.

rehabilitation.rationale: Penal philosophy is outside a territorial-unification idea, and adherents carry no shared line on it.

traditional-family.rationale: Nationalist culture stresses family and tradition; inferred from the nationalist milieu, not documented.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Social attitudes among adherents are mostly conservative; inferred.

abortion-legal.rationale: No ideological line; adherents split by religion (Muslim, Catholic, Orthodox) and by party.

more-religion-public.rationale: Albanianism put nation above religion, and the League of Prizren leadership wanted an identity cutting across faiths.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Not an issue the ideology addresses.

gender-social-construct.rationale: No position; inferred from nationalist cultural conservatism.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Cultural and linguistic unity of Albanians, with Illyrian continuity myths, is the basis of the claim to one nation.

gradual-change.rationale: Greater Albania seeks redrawing borders, but mainstream adherents now pursue it peacefully; leans against deferring to existing institutions.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Not addressed; Albanians are an emigrant nation with a large diaspora.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Adherents look to the EU and NATO for Albanian integration but resent outside-imposed borders; split.

free-trade.rationale: Not addressed; adherents desire EU integration yet no stated trade doctrine.

nation-first.rationale: National interest, including unification, is primary, but adherents also seek EU and NATO membership; inferred.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Kosovo Albanians welcomed the 1999 NATO intervention to stop Serbian repression.

open-borders.rationale: Borders dividing Albanians are the grievance, so open borders among Albanian lands are favoured, though not generally.

limit-growth.rationale: Not addressed; development and catching up are priorities after communist isolation.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The idea has nothing to say on climate; adherents follow their parties' differing environmental stances.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Technology is not part of the national-unification programme, and no adherent consensus exists.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Energy policy is unrelated to the claim; Albania's own energy debates are hydro-based and not tied to nationalism.

revolution-justified.rationale: Albanian national movements justified armed uprising against Ottoman, Yugoslav and Serbian rule (Kaçak, KLA), though mainstream now disavows violence for borders.

experts-over-public.rationale: The idea is about national self-determination and has no doctrine on expert versus popular rule.

central-planning.rationale: Hoxha's planned economy is associated with isolation, and it neglected Kosovo; inferred mild no.

socialized-markets.rationale: Not addressed; left and right adherents differ.

land-value-tax.rationale: A single-tax scheme is wholly outside the concept; adherents have no position on it.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inheritance taxation is not addressed in the idea or by its main carriers.

basic-income.rationale: No source ties pan-Albanianism to a basic income, and adherents differ by party on welfare.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Not addressed; Vetëvendosje-style developmentalism favours it but the concept itself does not.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Not addressed by the core concept.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Property distribution is not addressed; adherents range from liberal to developmental-state parties.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: A nation-state-building nationalism has no place for abolishing money; clearly outside the idea.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Inferred from state-building aims; not addressed.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-recognised wage bargaining is not part of the idea and has no documented adherent line.

one-party-rule.rationale: Albania's one-party communist state under Hoxha was the period when nationalism and the Kosovo cause were sidelined; adherents today work through multiparty politics.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Zog's monarchy did not pursue irredentism; adherents split between republicans and monarchists.

democracy-best.rationale: Current adherents work through elections and referendums, but the concept is not a theory of government.

direct-votes.rationale: Adherents call for a referendum on unification, implying support for direct votes on this major question.

workers-councils.rationale: Not part of the concept; inferred from its national rather than class basis.

right-to-secede.rationale: Kosovo Albanians claim self-determination up to secession, citing the 1943 Bujan declaration.

natural-rulers.rationale: Albanian nationalism claims popular national self-rule; no doctrine of natural rulers.

political-violence-never.rationale: The KLA and Kaçak tradition used violence and are venerated, while ICG notes violence for borders is unpopular; adherents split.

war-builds-character.rationale: Not a stated doctrine; inferred from adherents' general posture.

separate-church-state.rationale: Albanianism claims a secular national identity above Muslim, Catholic and Orthodox divisions.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Albanian nationalism is multi-faith and deliberately secular as its unifying principle.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Inferred from the concept's aim of a unified state that provides national defence; no source discusses private courts or defence agencies.

military-superiority.rationale: Not stated; Albanian states are small and seek NATO protection.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Greater Albania defines the nation by Albanian ethnicity and language, claiming lands for their Albanian populations.

class-struggle-history.rationale: National struggle against partition is the organising frame, not class.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Not addressed; adherents split between left and right.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Illyrian-descent claims to Kosovo are an indigeneity argument, but statement is about indigenous peoples in general; inferred.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Albanian nationalists claim grievances against Ottoman, Serb and Greek rule, but not colonial reparations as such, so the idea stays neutral.

civilizational-union.rationale: Albanianism puts nation over religion, so union on shared faith is not its model.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Collective national interest takes priority; inferred.

duties-before-rights.rationale: The concept stresses collective national claims, but no source frames it as duties over rights, so it is a split.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Environmental philosophy is not addressed by the idea or its carriers.

limit-population.rationale: Albanian nationalism has stressed demographic strength of Albanians; inferred.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Nothing in the concept concerns the pace of technological change.

human-enhancement.rationale: Bioethics lie outside a territorial national project.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Cryptography policy is unrelated to the unification claim.

restore-past-order.rationale: Restoration of the 1878 or 1943 maps is a motif, but the rebirth is toward a future national state; split.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Adherents are driven by a nationalist goal but argue pragmatically about means; no clear stance either way.

direct-action.rationale: Kaçak and KLA direct action coexist with electoral politics today; split.

means-match-ends.rationale: Methods debates among adherents range from peaceful referendum to armed struggle, so there is no single position.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Inferred from the concept's modern nation-state-building aims; no source discusses foraging.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Inferred from the state-building purpose of the concept; no source discusses the division of labour.

distribute-by-need.rationale: A distribution principle is not part of the idea; carriers differ on left and right.

production-for-use.rationale: Economic organisation is not addressed by the territorial concept.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Not part of the concept; inferred from its national frame.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Hoxha-style communism sidelined the Albanian national question; the idea is nationalist, not class-dictatorial.

collective-farming.rationale: Collectivisation under Hoxha is not a part of the idea; inferred.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: The concept blames partition by great powers, not capitalism; inferred.

taxation-theft.rationale: No libertarian element; the project assumes a taxing state.

harm-principle.rationale: Liberal limits on state power are not an issue the idea addresses, and adherents are not united.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Claims are for national, collective rights of Albanians across borders.

conscription.rationale: National defence is valued; KLA tradition; inferred.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Not addressed; adherents want states, not exit.

positive-liberty.rationale: Philosophical accounts of freedom do not figure in the concept; no documented stance.

media-academia-power.rationale: The concept has no theory of media or university influence.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Albanian nationalism is founded on language and descent, but not documented as a racial-ability doctrine; inferred.

organic-representation.rationale: Not addressed; adherents operate through parties.

total-state.rationale: The nationalism is not totalitarian; communist total state is associated with its suppression.

national-rebirth.rationale: Rilindja (the national awakening) is the founding frame, though the statement's 'decadence' is not documented.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Greater Albania seeks to enlarge the state, but through unification of co-ethnics rather than power projection.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Inferred from the modern nation-state project behind the concept; no source discusses rule through personal oaths.

bound-labor.rationale: Inferred from the modern national idea behind the concept; no source discusses bound labour.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Albanian nationalists contest Serb and Greek historiography, but no general epistemic doctrine is documented.

universal-morality.rationale: Moral philosophy is not a part of the idea; adherents hold varied religious and secular views.

single-common-good.rationale: The concept speaks of one national interest but there is no stated theory of a rationally derived common good.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Not addressed; inferred only by analogy with national self-determination.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Albanian nationalism emphasises the diaspora as part of the nation; inferred.

revive-national-language.rationale: Albanian was never out of use, so the question rarely arises; though language is central to the national idea.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Firm governance is not addressed by the concept; carriers differ by party.

school-vouchers.rationale: Education finance is not addressed by the idea.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Fiscal policy is outside the concept and adherents have no consensus.

economic-freedom.rationale: Adherents run from liberal-market to left-developmental, so the idea is indifferent.

national-self-determination.rationale: The resolution promises the Albanian people of Kosovo the right to decide their own fate by self-determination, even to secession.

force-without-un.rationale: Kosovo's liberation depended on NATO action without a UN mandate; inferred.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Albanianism is secular as a national identity, but adherents include many believers, so there is no consistent stance.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Immigrant welfare entitlement is not a concern of the concept, which focuses on borders and co-ethnics.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Welfare conditionality is not addressed by the idea or its carriers.

class-collaboration.rationale: National unity over class division is implied; inferred.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Cultural heritage is the core of the national claim; inconsistent.

dominated-front.rationale: Not addressed; Albanians generally look to the West.

workers-nation.rationale: Class is secondary to the nation in the idea; inferred.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Gender law is not addressed by the idea; adherents hold mixed views, and traditionalism is unevenly shared.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Albanians themselves suffered discrimination as minorities, and the movement does not advocate segregation.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Energy extraction policy has no bearing on the unification claim.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Not addressed; Albanianization of minorities is documented, but not about immigrants.

proportional-representation.rationale: Electoral systems are not part of the concept; adherents work within each state's existing system.

national-mission.rationale: Albanian nationalism is defensive and unificatory, not missionary.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Feminist social theory is not addressed by the concept, and adherents are divided.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Nationalist movements, including Vetëvendosje, run on anti-corruption; inferred.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Inferred: limits on reproduction are not part of the Greater Albania idea and no source discusses them.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Albanian nationalists demand accountability for Serbian killings in Kosovo; inferred.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Not a doctrine; Albanian nationalism is multi-faith and national, not racial.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Albanians claim equal rights, but nationalists have been accused of denying Slavs' rights in Kosovo; inferred.

socialism-one-country.rationale: The question comes from Marxist debate and is not relevant to Albanian nationalism.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Albanian nationalists view Serb settlement of Kosovo and Slavic rule as colonisation; inferred.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Albanianism treats Muslims and Christians as one nation with one law; inferred.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Religious freedom within the multi-faith nation is assumed; inferred.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Inferred: cattle slaughter is not part of the Greater Albania idea and no source discusses it.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Secular nation tradition; inferred. Communist ban of religion also happened.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Adherents argue for referendums and self-determination of Albanian populations.

trade-surplus.rationale: No trade doctrine is documented for the idea; adherents look chiefly to EU integration.

population-transfer.rationale: Serb expulsions in WWII were a documented outcome, but adherents officially claim minority protection and demand Cham return; split lean no.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Armed struggle is part of the tradition.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Social Darwinist claims are not a documented element of Albanian nationalism.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Albanian parties have both been banned and defended; no adherent line is documented on banning parties.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Anti-Serbian and Yugoslav rule is framed as domination; inferred.

separated-powers.rationale: Modern Albanian parties favour constitutionalism; inferred.

vanguard-party.rationale: Hoxha's party-state is the opposite of the pan-Albanian programme.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Poverty is widespread in the region but the concept does not give the poor priority; adherents are split.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: A British housing question that has no bearing on Albanian nationalism.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Industrial relations law is unaddressed by the concept.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: The concept stresses demography as strength, but takes no stand on population as a cause of poverty.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Ethnic-majority nation framing and concerns about minority populations; inferred.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Sortition is not an idea in Albanian nationalism and no adherent view is documented.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Emergency powers are not addressed; adherents have both suffered and used extra-legal measures.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Price policy is not addressed; adherents differ on state economic roles.

party-controls-media.rationale: Associated with the communist regime that suppressed the national cause.

party-commands-army.rationale: Associated with the communist regime, not the pan-Albanian programme.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Naturalisation periods are not part of the concept, which stresses co-ethnic and diaspora ties.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Politicians' pay is not addressed by the concept.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Party organisation is not part of the idea; the movement runs across many parties.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Albanian governments and nationalists in Kosovo want EU membership, and see integration as a way to overcome divided borders.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Constitutional design of command is not a concern of the idea.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Not addressed; Albanians are mostly Muslim.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Nationalists call for national solidarity in war.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: No documented adherent stance on censoring art; cultural expression is mainly valued as national heritage.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Term limits are not addressed by the idea.

recall-officials.rationale: Recall votes are not part of the concept and adherents have no common stance.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Albanians seek NATO membership and the US alliance; inferred.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Housing tenure policy is outside the concept.

people-in-arms.rationale: KLA and guerrilla tradition support, modern national armies the norm; split.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Highland mythology exists, but not a doctrine.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: The Bujan resolution says Kosovo and the Dukagjin plateau have always wanted to be united with Albania and sets out how that union is to be won.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Anti-intellectualism is not part of the idea, and nationalist movements include many intellectuals, so it is a split.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Not addressed; Albanian nationalists deny Slavs' historical rights but not as hierarchy of culture.

death-penalty.rationale: Albania and Kosovo abolished it, and nationalists have not made it an issue, so there is no consistent position.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Not addressed by the concept; adherents' views follow their religious and political backgrounds.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Not addressed by the concept; no consistent adherent stance.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Ethnic-nation framing and diaspora emphasis; documented in the ethnic basis of Greater Albania.

minority-language-support.rationale: Albanians in Yugoslavia suffered language discrimination, and the ICG records Ohrid Agreement language provisions as a gain.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Albanianism treats all faiths as part of one nation, but exemption law is not addressed by the idea.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: A Millian question not taken up by the concept or its carriers.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: International debt policy is not addressed by the idea.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Not addressed; independence and unification are the concern.

constituent-assembly.rationale: The 1912 Vlorë assembly founded Albania; inferred approval of assemblies.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Hoxha's isolation and repression are not seen as a model.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Global aid duties are not addressed; adherents seek aid for the Balkans through the EU, but this is no general doctrine.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Constitutional choice of head of state is not part of the concept.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Monetary institutions are not addressed by the concept.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Adherents hold claims to territories as historic homelands; inferred.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Property theory is outside the concept and adherents differ by party.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Marxist classification debates have no bearing on Albanian nationalism.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Environmental regulation philosophy is not addressed by the concept.

collective-defense.rationale: NATO membership is a goal of adherents; inferred.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Kosovo's incorporation into Yugoslavia at Prizren 1945 by a handpicked group is regarded as imposed, not consented.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Hoxha banned religion in 1967, but adherents today defend multi-faith pluralism; split.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Role of the head of state is not addressed; Albanian monarchists and republicans both exist.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Albanians opposed Serbian military suppression of Kosovo, so they reject force to hold a region.

region-keeps-system.rationale: League of Prizren sought an autonomous province within the Ottoman Empire; Ohrid-style autonomy is accepted.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Tax structure is not addressed by the concept.

character-from-environment.rationale: Nature-nurture is not an issue for the concept, although the idea emphasises inherited ethnic identity, so it is a split.

space-expansion.rationale: Space policy is irrelevant to a Balkan territorial nationalism.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Classical constitutional theory is not part of the concept.

leader-cult.rationale: Hoxha's cult is associated with the regime that suppressed national claims.

equal-parenting.rationale: Family-court policy is not addressed by the concept.

land-redistribution.rationale: Estate breakup was part of both interwar Albanian politics and communism, but the concept itself takes no side.

refugee-return.rationale: The Cham expulsion from Greece in 1945 and property claims are a central Albanian grievance; ICG says the Chams' grievances are legitimate.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: The resolution grounds Kosovo's union with Albania in the region being inhabited by an Albanian majority.

women-must-cover.rationale: Secular Albanianism does not require this.

common-currency.rationale: Vetëvendosje proposes a currency union with Albania; inferred as a mild yes among adherents.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Albanians are an isolated language branch, and unity claims are on co-ethnics, not language families; inferred.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: The defining aim is one state for Albanians, not minority autonomy inside existing states, though the League of Prizren first sought autonomy.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: The core idea answers division by unification, though many Albanians in North Macedonia and elsewhere accept rights-based settlements; inferred and contested.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Inferred from the idea's reliance on national identity and shared descent rather than economic explanation of history.

ban-cartels.rationale: No economic programme in the core idea; contemporary carriers seek EU membership, whose competition rules they would accept, so a mild yes is inferred.

no-bailouts.rationale: The idea is territorial and carries no position on rescues; adherents are not documented as taking a side.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Inferred from the EU and NATO aspirations noted in the sources, which imply accepting rule-of-law institutions; not directly documented.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Inferred from Kosovo's gender-quota rules and Vetevendosje's stance as described for modern carriers; the core idea is silent.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Contemporary adherents pursue EU integration and open trade; autarky is inferred to be rejected.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Inferred from the EU-integration aim of contemporary adherents, since EU deals carry such standards; not addressed directly.

moral-incentives.rationale: The idea has no doctrine on work motivation; a market-oriented default is inferred.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: The KLA and ANA used armed force, but the mainstream now seeks unification by consent, so a mild yes is contested among adherents.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Inferred from a republican tradition in modern Albanian nationalism; hereditary rank is not discussed.

history-own-civilization.rationale: A unification nationalism built on shared Albanian identity and history, as in the League of Prizren, implies a nation-centred history; inferred.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Albanians were long ruled by Ottoman and Balkan powers, so tutelage claims are inferred as rejected.

patriotic-education.rationale: Nationalist movements from Prizren to the present stress national identity, flag and language; inferred from this.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: The idea is territorial only and has no line on admissions or hiring preferences.

public-money-creation.rationale: No monetary programme; adherents are inferred as neutral.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: No economic doctrine; adherents are inferred as neutral.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Albania held no empire to restore, and the movement seeks unification of Albanians, not rule beyond; inferred.

delink-world-market.rationale: Mainstream carriers seek EU integration and NATO membership, so delinking is inferred as rejected.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Not addressed by a territorial nationalism; inferred as neutral.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Mainstream carriers aim at EU norms, which restrict discrimination; inferred.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: The mainstream seeks EU and NATO states with constitutional rights guarantees; inferred.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: The 1912-13 borders set by the great powers split Albanian lands, and the project is built on undoing that division.

elective-rulers.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: the 1912 independence assembly and modern Albanian politics are electoral, so elected rulers are the default.

minority-veto.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: a national-unification project stresses collective decisions of the nation, not individual vetoes.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: the League of Prizren and 1912 declaration stand on constitutional self-rule, so resisting a lawless ruler fits.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: modern Albanian states are parliamentary republics and the idea has no monarchist strand in the cited sources.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: the idea says nothing on animals; mainstream European views are assumed.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: the idea says nothing on animals; humane use is the mainstream default.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: no doctrine on obligation of the wealthy; a mild yes follows from general Albanian social norms.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: a national movement is politically active by nature, so withdrawal contradicts it.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Inferred at low confidence: the idea has no media theory; nationalists value mass culture as a carrier of national identity.

notes: Positions vary by strand: the League of Prizren sought only autonomy within the Ottoman Empire, Hoxha and Zog did not pursue irredentism, the KLA and ANA used force, and most current adherents want unification by consent or a Kosovo-Albania partnership. Polls cited on Wikipedia show widely varying support for unification.
